The Nuggets are still all-in on their championship core 😤 It's normal for teams who win a title to run it back. But after a year or two, the championship core usually gets broken up. It's usually because of age or trying to duck the luxury tax. The Celtics only have one player left from their starting 5 when they won a title in 2024. The OKC Thunder already traded 2 players from their core this offseason. There've been a lot of rumors the past few seasons that the Nuggets we're willing to trade everyone but Nikola Jokic. But the Nuggets have stayed the course. They re-acquired Bruce Brown after he left in the offseason to get a bag. The only players from their core that are no longer on the team are Michael Porter Jr. and KCP. A lot has changed in the NBA the past 3 years, but the Nuggets keep finding ways to bring the band back together 🔥
